title: Equal Superposition
subtitle: Create uniform probability across all basis states
description: Build a circuit on 3 qubits where every basis state (|000⟩ through |111⟩) has an equal 12.5% probability of being measured. This is a fundamental building block of many quantum algorithms.
hint: Think about which single gate creates equal superposition on one qubit. Apply it to all three.
objectives: Extend single-qubit operations to multi-qubit registers
